import json
with open('/app/resources/treasury_bulletin_1953_01.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Print keys at top level

# Look for circulation-related data
def find_circulation(obj, path=''):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            if 'circul' in k.lower():
                print(f'{path}.{k}: {v}')
            find_circulation(v, f'{path}.{k}')
    elif isinstance(obj, list) and len(obj) > 0:
        find_circulation(obj[0], f'{path}[0]')

find_circulation(data)
"
